name: churn-signals
description: Guided build for a churn-signals pipeline on unstructured customer data already in Snowflake. Extracts churn reasons, aspect sentiment, churn intent, competitor mentions and verbatim-grounded evidence from support tickets, survey verbatims, emails and CSM call notes with Cortex AI functions (AI_CLASSIFY multi-label, AI_SENTIMENT, AI_COMPLETE structured output, AI_SUMMARIZE_AGG); joins them point-in-time to usage and ARR under a label-leakage audit; trains and registers a Snowflake ML churn model compared against a usage-only baseline; batch-scores open renewals in SQL into a ranked at-risk list with reasons and cited evidence; and reports churned ARR by reason, measured reason precision/recall, model AUC/lift/calibration, and credits per 1K interactions. Ships a deterministic synthetic sandbox with a labeled answer key and planted leakage traps. For B2B and subscription businesses protecting revenue retention.
